turns.question: Tell me about Wakefield Christmas Market on Wood Street in December
turns.reply:
Wakefield Christmas Market runs on Friday 11 December 2026 and Saturday 12 December 2026 and Sunday 13 December 2026, at Wood Street, Wakefield city centre.

Wood Street will become a festive Christmas market from 11 to 13 December. Browse Christmas gifts, decorations and festive products from a range of traders. You can also enjoy food and drink from local businesses. Please note that Wood Street will be closed to traffic from 10 to 14 December. Dates: 11 to 13 December Times: Friday and Saturday: 10am - 6pm, Sunday: 10am - 5pm Wakefield Council is working with Market Place to host this event. Local traders interested in taking part in the market can apply.

[Event details](https://www.wakefield.gov.uk/wakefield-events/christmas-in-the-wakefield-district)

turns.question: Tell me more about Tileyard North Christmas Market
turns.reply:
Tileyard North Christmas Market runs on Thursday 26 November 2026 and Friday 27 November 2026 and Saturday 28 November 2026 and Sunday 29 November 2026 and Thursday 3 December 2026 and Friday 4 December 2026 and Saturday 5 December 2026 and Sunday 6 December 2026 and Thursday 10 December 2026 and Friday 11 December 2026 and Saturday 12 December 2026 and Sunday 13 December 2026 and Thursday 17 December 2026 and Friday 18 December 2026 and Saturday 19 December 2026 and Sunday 20 December 2026, at Tileyard North. It’s free to attend.

Tileyard North is bringing a brand-new Christmas market to Wakefield this festive season!

Browse more than 20 independent traders selling gifts, crafts and seasonal treats, tuck into delicious street food, and enjoy live music throughout the event. Visitors can also experience the atmosphere of the Bavarian Winter Hall, try their hand at curling, and gather around for some festive marshmallow toasting.

Set beneath twinkling lights and filled with festive atmosphere, the Tileyard North Courtyard Christmas Market is set to become a welcome addition to Wakefield’s Christmas celebrations.

[Event details](https://experiencewakefield.co.uk/event/tileyard-north-christmas-market/)
